authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full prabhāta means daybreak and includes Pali pabhāta dawn. Selected perbāt/pārbʰāt morning retain the pr-bh-t frame with metathesis/epenthesis and aspiration differences stated as qualifications; the retained medial consonant suggests a learned or regionally transmitted form rather than the fully reduced Prakrit pahāya branch. Local IA mediation versus learned transmission is unresolved. Nasal/spirant pārəvā̃t is excluded pending closer evidence. Exact response: pārbʰāt.
